Recommendation: approve containment-only execution and authorize no new discretionary spend, monetization expansion, or budget commitment. AI spend was $963.569 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26 across 5,390 calls; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and other operating costs are not reported. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the $4.92 is in Amazon's aggregate tracking row and cannot be assigned to a site without inventing attribution. Contribution margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, and budget exposure are therefore not calculable. Minimum measurement is a period-aligned cost ledger matched to site-attributed commission, experiment-level cost and incremental outcomes, and owner-approved monthly spend, fixed-cost, marketing, revenue-floor, and attribution-materiality limits with actual-versus-budget reporting. Continue only source-dated measurement already scheduled; treat impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, AI calls, and technical scores as operating metrics, not financial returns.
